note: Reusable quest templates. The brain instantiates these with fresh numbers/topics each day. Every quest carries a 'topic' (the theory it comes from). Reading quests use type:'reading' + read_minutes (a timed read session).
cadence_note: Two cadences only: 'weekday' and 'weekend'. The day is released whole — there is no morning/evening split and no Morning Window, so a weekday template is simply part of the one day list. read_minutes are real reading times (~2-3 min per page of technical material), not token timers.
gce_note: GCE templates are SUBJECT-AGNOSTIC: front 'gce-*' and a '{subject}' placeholder that the server fills in. Never hardcode one subject here — that is what left Physics, Chemistry, Maths and Further Maths at zero for the System's first weeks. 'gce_slot' says how the server picks the subject: 'primary' = the most-neglected subject (read and drill share it, so the read gates the drill), 'rotate' = the next subjects in the need order, so one day touches several.

templates.title: Read & absorb: {subject}
templates.detail: Timed reading of your weakest {subject} topic before you drill it. No skipping — the timer runs.

templates.title: {subject} recurring-skill drill
templates.detail: One Paper-2-style structured task on the weakest/overdue {subject} skill, full working required.

templates.title: Weekend GCE mock — {subject}
templates.detail: A timed structured block or full MCQ set for {subject}, marked per-part.

templates.title: Trading Geeks — 30-minute study session
templates.detail:
A timed 30-minute study session on Brad Goh's Trading Geeks YouTube channel, picking up where you left off.
This is study, not watching: take notes as you go.
templates.submit: Your notes: the concept taught, and one line on what it changes about how you'd act.

templates.title: Read ~10 pages: one concept
templates.detail:
Targeted read of the next ~10 pages of one book in library/trading-business/, picked up from where you stopped.
Read FOR the concept named in the topic — not to turn pages. Timer runs.
templates.topic: Next concept from the trading library (auto)
templates.submit: The concept in your own words, and the page range you covered.

templates.title: Log today's Written Vibes build
templates.detail: Record what actually shipped. Honest no-progress days are logged as such.

templates.title: {subject} MCQ mixed set
templates.detail: 3-5 fresh Paper-1-style MCQs across mixed {subject} modules.

templates.title: Study a winning-essay pattern
templates.detail: Timed read of what your target programme rewards before you write. Timer runs.

templates.title: Essay loop stage
templates.detail: One stage (frame / evidence / draft / cut) on one scholarship prompt.

templates.title: {subject} structured question
templates.detail:
One structured question on an untested {subject} topic.
Show every step — method marks count, not just the final answer.

templates.title: Tech-club concrete action
templates.detail: One shippable action toward the current milestone (message, agenda, pitch).

order_note: Array order is PRIORITY. generateDay() slices the filtered templates down to the day's load, so whatever sits last is what gets dropped on a full day. Daily staples (the GCE read+drill, the 30-min Brad Goh session, the trading read, the app-log) are deliberately first; weekend-only heavy work is filtered out on weekdays anyway.
